title: alarm sound
symptom: The user reports that xDrip alarms are extremely loud, especially at night, and asks for a way to reduce the volume. They note that the only options are high, medium, or ascending, and request a low or selectable option.
fix: A maintainer suggests choosing a custom file for alerts with low volume to reduce overall volume. Another user later mentions using Samsung Sound Assistant to lower the volume of specific apps.
evidence_quote: You can choose a custom file for your alerts. Choose something with low volume, then the total volume will not be too strong.
